annotation_protocol: One label per molecule × bilayer_type × run. Inspect the available views. Use uncertain when evidence is ambiguous. Membranes are independent. Bulge implies interaction; flat/curved describes the surrounding membrane. Use pore_formed for a visible formed pore. Existing labels are not automatically reclassified.

classes.description: Apply the agreed manual classification protocol.
